reuse.why: Collapses the five copied link functions into linkBankSyncAccount, generalises the Pluggy download into downloadBankSyncTransactions for Akahu and Fintegra, and reuses the unlink logic through clearAccountBankLink.

duplication.why: Removes the existing per-provider copies instead of adding a sixth; each provider wrapper only supplies its provider, account and bank id.

placement.why: Link rules sit in accounts/app.ts next to the handlers, the download stays in sync.ts, and the URL goes in server-config, as the tree layers them.

scope.why: The broad rewrite of the link functions serves the steps' shared rules; small side effects (Akahu now also notifies 'accounts', GoCardless now passes fileId) come along unannounced.

maintainability.why: One link path with a wrapper for the pre-link checks and explicit provider/bankId parameters is easy to own; the loose BankSyncLinkAccount typing of institution and the handler-level wrapper repeated six times are minor costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through withBankAccountLinkCheck and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount uses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Copies are removed and replaced by calls to the shared functions, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink for step 4 (the requested rule); the per-provider differences are explicit parameters (provider, bankId, optional mask/official_name); processBankSyncDownload's akahu branch is extended to fintegra outside the helper; SimpleFin and Enable Banking downloads keep their own functions for real request differences.
